mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals sustained monetary accommodation that compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% indicates labor market deterioration that triggers recessionary fears, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as earnings face sector-wide pressure.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between the joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS and SPX 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 230.0 indicates high inflation that forces the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230.0.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) rising above 130,000 thousand indicate labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising (monthly change > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) signals economic contraction that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between the joint decline of INDPRO and GDPC1 and SPX 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 700.0 thousand units indicate housing market collapse that drags down consumer confidence and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 700.0.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 400,000 million dollars indicate robust consumer spending that boosts corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 400000.0.
